CustomField.description: Reimbursements received to date on this grant. Maintained by the DLRS roll-up Total_Award_Paid (dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2), which sums Received Gift Transaction Total (Received_Gift_Transaction_Total__c) across every Gift Commitment linked to this Opportunity. That commitment field is itself a DLRS roll-up (Received_Gift_Transaction_Total) summing OriginalAmount on its Gift Transactions. A native roll-up summary is not possible because Gift Transactions are children of the Gift Commitment, not of the Opportunity. Do not edit by hand; the next roll-up recalculation overwrites it. See docs/grant-reimbursement-rollups.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Reimbursements received to date, totalled from the Gift Transactions under this grant's Gift Commitment. Calculated - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Total Award Paid
